newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.

text.p: Dutch bonds underperformed their German equivalents to close mixed with longer maturities finishing higher and shorter dates ending lower.
Dealers said the spread to Bunds continued to narrow, ending at seven basis points in the 10-year sector, where the 5.72 percent closing yield is the lowest since January 1994.
The yield discount was 12 basis points only last week and hit a recent high of 16 basis points in September.
A trader said holders of government paper sold into the strength to crystallise gains from this year's strong rally.
"We have a lot of paper in from domestic funds," he said.
